description_en: Queries user account information by user identity ID (IdentityId) or third-party platform user ID (OpenId)
description_zh: 调用该接口根据用户身份ID（IdentityId）或三方平台用户ID（OpenId）查询用户账号信息
name: GetAccountById

parameters.help_en:
The third-party platform user ID.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify OpenIdAppKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
三方平台用户ID。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入OpenIdAppKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: open_id

parameters.help_en:
The AppKey issued by the third-party platform.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify OpenId.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
三方平台颁发的AppKey。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入OpenId。
</notice>
parameters.name: open_id_app_key

parameters.help_en:
The user identity ID.

<notice> IdentityId serves as the user identifier and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of OpenId and OpenIdAppKey. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify OpenId or OpenIdAppKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
用户身份ID。

<notice> IdentityId作为用户标识符，和OpenId与OpenIdAppKey组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入OpenId和OpenIdAppKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: identity_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the account was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the account was last modified

LastLoginTime.description_en: The last logon time, in the format of a 13-digit millisecond-level timestamp
LastLoginTime.description_zh: 最后登录时间，13位毫秒级时间戳

LoginName.description_en: The logon name of the account

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
